text.p: SunGard Data Systems Inc said Thursday it expects to post earnings in the 1997 fiscal year of between $1.86 and $1.91 per fully diluted share.
SunGard Chairman and Chief Executive James Mann offered that projection in a statement as the company released its fourth quarter and 1996 full-year results.

For the full year, SunGard posted net income of $34.9 million, or $0.81 per fully diluted share, on revenues of $670.3 million, versus net income of $48.7 million, or $1.23 per fully diluted share, on revenues of $532.6 million.

For the quarter, the company reported net income of $14.5 million, or $0.34 per fully diluted share, on revenues of $193.3 million. In the prior year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $13.3 million, or $0.31 per fully diluted share, on revenues of $153.9 million.
